item.summary: fix(gateway): pin git config for session-diff and worker workspace paths (#130124) * fix(gateway): pin git config for session-diff and worker workspace paths session-diff's baseline capture, the worker workspace fallback's local inspection, and worker workspace result staging still spawned git against user checkouts without pinning core.hooksPath/core.fsmonitor, unlike the managed worktrees service (#129968) and publication git transport. Route gitOutForBaseline through the worktrees git seam's exported gitEnvironment, and pin the remaining two direct git invocations the same way. * fix(tests): stop status.agent-local mock from replacing fs-safe.js wholesale This test's core.fsmonitor-unrelated commands shard runs isolate:false, so a full-replacement vi.mock("../infra/fs-safe.js", () => ({ pathExists })) here could leak into agents.delete.test.ts later in the same worker and drop readLocalFileSafely, which src/media/store.runtime.ts imports. The other two fs-safe.js mockers in this directory already spread importOriginal(); align this one with that pattern. * fix(tests): complete agents.delete fs-safe.js mocks via importOriginal Both files fully replaced ../infra/fs-safe.js with on
